payload.description_html: Vectaerovenator is a medium sized theropod whose fossil remains indicate an individual that was approximately 4 m in length, though it was not yet fully grown so could likely be larger. Due to the fragmentary nature of these remains, its taxonomic placement is unclear. Vectaerovenator may have been a megaraptoran, or possibly a basal tyrannosauroid.
